title: Uncertainty Remains Over New Gaza Peace Plan
subtitle: Questions persist regarding the order of disarmament and troop withdrawal as international leaders react to the proposed roadmap.

summary.en: Donald Trump recently announced a potential breakthrough in Gaza peace negotiations. The plan involves the disarmament of Hamas and the withdrawal of Israeli forces from the territory. However, there is significant confusion regarding the order of these events. Hamas insists that disarmament must happen alongside a troop withdrawal, while Israeli officials remain skeptical. The situation remains tense as both sides wait for official confirmation and clear terms.
summary.zh: 川普近期宣布加薩和平談判可能出現突破。該計畫涉及哈瑪斯解除武裝以及以色列軍隊撤出該領土。然而，對於這些事件的先後順序存在重大混亂。哈瑪斯堅持解除武裝必須與撤軍同步進行，而以色列官員則持懷疑態度。由於雙方都在等待正式確認與明確條款，局勢依然緊張。

paragraphs.en: A new peace plan for Gaza has become the center of international attention following recent comments by Donald Trump. The proposal aims to address two of the most difficult issues in the ongoing conflict: the disarmament of Hamas and the withdrawal of Israeli military forces from the Gaza Strip. While the announcement suggests a possible path toward peace, significant questions remain about how and when these steps will actually happen.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著川普 (Donald Trump) 近期的評論，一項針對加薩走廊的和平新計畫已成為國際關注的焦點。該提案旨在解決當前衝突中最棘手的兩個問題：解除哈瑪斯 (Hamas) 武裝，以及以色列軍隊撤出加薩走廊。雖然這項宣布暗示了通往和平的可能路徑，但對於這些步驟將如何以及何時真正落實，仍存在重大疑問。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, Donald Trump claimed that Israel is happy with the new plan. However, the situation on the ground is far from clear. A major point of confusion is the sequence of events. It is currently unknown whether Hamas must give up its weapons first, or if Israeli troops must leave the area first. This lack of clarity has stalled the progress of a ceasefire—an agreement to stop fighting—that was originally discussed last October.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，川普聲稱以色列對這項新計畫感到滿意。然而，當地的實際情況卻遠未明朗。一個主要的混亂點在於事件的先後順序。目前尚不清楚是哈瑪斯必須先交出武器，還是以色列軍隊必須先撤離該地區。這種缺乏明確性的狀況，導致去年十月初步討論的停火協議進展陷入停滯。

paragraphs.en: Representatives from Hamas have provided their own perspective on the deal. A member of the Hamas negotiating team, Ghazi Hamad, stated that the group is willing to hand over its weapons to a new organization called the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza. However, Hamad emphasized that this action is conditional. He explained that Hamas will not give up its weapons until Israeli troops have withdrawn from the territory. The group insists that the process must be fair and that Israel must also commit to ending its military attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 哈瑪斯代表針對此協議提出了他們的觀點。哈瑪斯談判小組成員哈馬德 (Ghazi Hamad) 表示，該組織願意將武器移交給一個名為「加薩行政國家委員會」的新組織。然而，哈馬德強調此舉是有條件的。他解釋說，在以色列軍隊撤出該領土之前，哈瑪斯不會放棄武器。該組織堅持認為過程必須公平，且以色列也必須承諾停止軍事攻擊。

paragraphs.en: On the other side, the Israeli government has not yet officially accepted the agreement. Many Israeli officials have expressed doubt about the plan. One Israeli official noted that the country demands the complete disarmament of Hamas as a necessary first step before any other process can begin. This includes the removal of all weapons from the Gaza Strip. Furthermore, some Israeli leaders have described the current proposal as insufficient, arguing that it does not provide a satisfactory response to their security requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，以色列政府尚未正式接受該協議。許多以色列官員對此計畫表示懷疑。一位以色列官員指出，該國要求哈瑪斯徹底解除武裝，作為任何其他程序開始前的必要第一步。這包括從加薩走廊清除所有武器。此外，一些以色列領導人形容目前的提案不足，認為該計畫並未對其安全需求提供令人滿意的回應。

paragraphs.en: There is also disagreement regarding who will oversee the transition. While the peace plan mentions a new body called the Board of Peace to manage daily affairs, other reports have suggested that Palestinian authorities would be responsible for receiving the weapons. This confusion over the details has led to public criticism from some members of the Israeli government. For example, Itamar Ben-Gvir, the national security minister, has already dismissed the plan as unacceptable. Meanwhile, Israel’s ambassador to the United Nations, Danny Danon, stated that simple solutions will not work and that Hamas must truly lose its control over weapons before any progress can be made.
paragraphs.zh: 關於誰將監督過渡期，各方也存在分歧。雖然和平計畫提到了一個名為「和平委員會」的新機構來管理日常事務，但其他報導則指出，巴勒斯坦當局將負責接收這些武器。這種細節上的混亂引發了以色列政府部分成員的公開批評。例如，國家安全部長班吉維爾 (Itamar Ben-Gvir) 已駁回該計畫，稱其不可接受。與此同時，以色列駐聯合國大使達諾 (Danny Danon) 表示，簡單的解決方案行不通，在取得任何進展之前，哈瑪斯必須真正失去對武器的控制。

paragraphs.en: As these discussions continue, the broader Middle East remains in a state of high tension. The conflict has recently expanded, with reports of increased fighting between the United States and Iran. These regional challenges make the situation in Gaza even more complicated. For now, the world is waiting for official confirmation from the Israeli government and more specific details on how the proposed roadmap will be implemented. Until both sides can agree on the order of disarmament and withdrawal, the path to a lasting peace remains uncertain.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著這些討論持續進行，整個中東地區仍處於高度緊張狀態。衝突近期有所擴大，有報導指出美國與伊朗之間的戰鬥加劇。這些區域挑戰使加薩局勢變得更加複雜。目前，全世界都在等待以色列政府的正式確認，以及關於擬議路線圖將如何實施的更具體細節。在雙方就解除武裝與撤軍的順序達成共識之前，通往持久和平的道路依然充滿不確定性。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop or delay the progress of something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（攤位）或指引擎熄火，這裡指進展停滯。文中：This lack of clarity has stalled the progress of a ceasefire—an agreement to stop fighting—that was originally discussed last October.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To decide that something is not important enough to consider.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 不予理會、認為不值得考慮。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指解僱員工，這裡指對意見或計畫的否定。文中：For example, Itamar Ben-Gvir, the national security minister, has already dismissed the plan as unacceptable.

keyTerms.definitionEn: In the actual, real-life situation, rather than in theory or in reports.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 在實際現場、在現實情況中。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「在地上」，這裡指實際發生的情況。文中：However, the situation on the ground is far from clear.

quiz.question: What is the specific condition set by Hamas for surrendering their weapons?

options.A: They will surrender weapons only after the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza is fully funded.
options.B: They will only give up their weapons once Israeli military forces have withdrawn from the Gaza Strip.
options.C: They demand that the United Nations oversee the transition process before any disarmament begins.
options.D: They require a formal guarantee from the United States that Iran will stop its involvement in the region.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，Hamas 的談判代表 Ghazi Hamad 明確指出，他們願意交出武器，但條件是必須等到以色列軍隊從該領土撤離後才會執行。選項 A 提到的資金問題文中並未提及；選項 C 雖提到新組織，但並未要求聯合國監管；選項 D 雖然提到區域緊張，但這並非 Hamas 提出交出武器的先決條件。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why is the peace plan currently stalled?

options.A: Because both Hamas and Israel have officially rejected the proposal in its entirety.
options.B: Because the United States and Iran have increased their fighting, making a ceasefire impossible.
options.C: Because there is a fundamental disagreement over whether disarmament or withdrawal should happen first.
options.D: Because the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza refuses to take responsibility for the weapons.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段與第三、四段的對比，Hamas 要求先撤軍再繳械，而以色列官員則堅持必須先繳械才能開始任何進程。這種對「順序」的僵持導致了和平進程停滯。選項 A 不正確，因為以色列尚未正式拒絕，僅表達疑慮；選項 B 是區域背景，非停滯的主因；選項 D 文中並未提到該委員會拒絕責任。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'dismissed' mean in the context of Itamar Ben-Gvir's reaction to the plan?

options.A: He rejected the plan as unworthy of consideration.
options.B: He sent the plan to a lower-level committee for review.
options.C: He asked for more time to study the details of the proposal.
options.D: He fired the people responsible for creating the peace plan.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第五段中，Itamar Ben-Gvir 稱該計畫為「不可接受的」（unacceptable），這顯示他對該計畫持否定態度並拒絕採納，因此「dismissed」在此處是指「駁回、不予理會」。選項 B 與 C 與「駁回」的強烈否定語氣不符；選項 D 雖然有「解僱」之意，但在本段語境中，他是針對「計畫」而非「人員」，故不適用。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the central message of the article?

options.A: The new peace plan has successfully brought Hamas and Israel to a final agreement.
options.B: The peace plan faces significant obstacles due to conflicting demands and lack of clarity on implementation.
options.C: The involvement of the United States and Iran is the only reason the peace plan has not been accepted.
options.D: Israel is ready to accept the peace plan as long as the United Nations manages the transition.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文重點在於介紹一項新的和平計畫，並詳細說明了為何該計畫面臨困境，包括雙方對執行順序的爭執、對管理機構的不確定性以及官員的質疑。選項 A 與事實不符，目前尚未達成協議；選項 C 過度簡化，區域衝突僅是背景因素；選項 D 與文意矛盾，文中提到的是對管理機構的混亂與疑慮，而非以色列要求聯合國介入。
